description: Change a status page's name, description, website, look or subscription button. Only the fields passed change. The page is public: confirm the change with the user first.

auto_refresh.description: Reload the page every minute, for a wall screen.

description.description: Short text under the page status. Empty string to remove it.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the description is written in. Defaults to the page's default language; the other translations are kept.

website.description: Company website, linked from the page header. Empty string to remove it.

name: update_status_page
title: Update status page settings
